hero.headline: DRONE IMAGERY SURVEYS
hero.title: Reliable. Scalable. Fast. Powerful.
hero.description: Unlock faster, more cost-effective, and safer mapping, measurement, and monitoring of 1000+ Acres at a time. With cutting-edge drones and land surveying techniques, we deliver actionable data across Africa and beyond.

items.title: Aerial Mapping
items.description: Accurate drone-based imagery for planning, documentation, and analysis.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid Surveying delivers ultra-precise aerial mapping using UAVs to generate georeferenced orthomosaics, topographic data, and planning-grade base maps. Our solutions support infrastructure, utilities, and land development with unmatched speed and accuracy.

items.title: Construction Monitoring
items.description: Track site activity using consistent, real-time aerial visuals.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid offers site monitoring through high-resolution drone flyovers. Our automated flights provide weekly visual updates, detect deviations from schedule, and support decision-making for project managers and developers.

items.title: Environmental Monitoring
items.description: Visualize ecological change and monitor conservation areas.
items.popupContent: Using UAVs, SmartGrid tracks land cover change, deforestation, erosion, and other ecological indicators. Our data supports impact assessments and regulatory compliance with repeatable, time-stamped visuals.

items.title: Agricultural Mapping
items.description: Drone-based multispectral data for crop health and farm optimization.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid empowers agronomists with data on crop health, plant stress, and irrigation patterns. We use NDVI and multispectral analysis to optimize input use and improve yield sustainability.

items.title: 3D Modeling
items.description: Photorealistic 3D models to support planning and inspections.
items.popupContent: We create detailed 3D mesh and textured models of terrain, buildings, and infrastructure. These models are BIM-ready and useful for design validation, inspection, and immersive planning.

items.title: Infrastructure Planning
items.description: Route and terrain data for smart infrastructure layout.
items.popupContent: We map routes and sites using drone LiDAR and photogrammetry. This ensures smart siting of roads, pipelines, and urban developments while minimizing environmental disruption.

items.title: DTMs & DEMs
items.description: Digital terrain and elevation models for hydrological and civil works.
items.popupContent: Our terrain and elevation models help civil engineers and hydrologists analyze runoff, slope stability, and grading. We deliver precise elevation data to support resilient infrastructure.

items.title: Volumetric Calculations
items.description: Calculate material volumes and manage resources accurately.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid computes cut/fill volumes and stockpile measurements with centimeter-level accuracy. Our aerial photogrammetry offers fast, safe, and repeatable results.

items.title: Disaster Assessment
items.description: Route and terrain data for smart infrastructure layout.
items.popupContent: After floods, landslides, or earthquakes, SmartGrid uses drones to quickly document damage. Our data helps responders prioritize actions, allocate aid, and plan recovery operations.

whyDronesMatter.headline: Why Drones Matter!
whyDronesMatter.description: Modern surveying is evolving—and drones sit at the heart of this transformation. They deliver speed, precision, safety, and powerful spatial insights that traditional methods alone cannot match. At Smartgrid Surveying, we deliver fast, accurate, and detailed surveys.

aerialSurveyDeliverables.headline: Aerial Surveys Deliverables
aerialSurveyDeliverables.description: Our drone‑based surveying solutions enhance decision‑making for construction, engineering, land administration, and environmental monitoring. We capture accurate geospatial data using advanced UAV platforms equipped with RGB, LiDAR, and thermal sensors. All outputs are optimized for use within GIS, CAD, BIM, and engineering workflows.

drones.headline: Our Drones
drones.description: At SmartGrid Surveying, we deploy advanced drones to capture high-resolution aerial imagery and multispectral data for accurate mapping, monitoring, and surveying.

items.label: DJI Matrice 300 RTK
items.description: The DJI Matrice 300 RTK is a versatile and powerful drone designed for industrial applications, including surveying, mapping, and inspection. It features advanced flight capabilities, long battery life, and the ability to carry various payloads, making it ideal for professional use in challenging environments.

items.label: DJI Air 3S
items.description: The DJI Air 3S is a compact and portable drone that offers high-quality aerial photography and videography capabilities. It features a dual-camera system, long flight time, and intelligent flight modes, making it suitable for both professional and recreational use.

items.label: DJI Mavic 3M / 3E
items.description: The DJI Mavic 3M / 3E is a lightweight and portable drone that provides excellent aerial imaging capabilities. It features a high-resolution camera, obstacle avoidance sensors, and intelligent flight modes, making it ideal for capturing stunning photos and videos from the sky.

items.label: DJI Phantom 4
items.description: The DJI Phantom 4 is a professional-grade drone designed for aerial photography and videography. It features a high-resolution camera with a large sensor, advanced flight modes, and obstacle avoidance technology, making it suitable for capturing high-quality images and videos from the air.
